description: Defines a UI fragment for managing reminders, including creating, listing, and interacting with reminder data using a mock in-memory repository and notification manager.

classes.name: RemindersFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that allows creating, listing, and managing reminders through a UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the repository and notification manager, setting up services for reminder management.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the reminders UI.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI elements, event listeners, and initializes the reminder list adapter.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches current reminders and updates the UI list display.
